sources.use: Primary-author abstract: space competition and branch growth from attractor points. Only abstract accessed; this patch is not a full implementation of the paper.
Primary-author abstract: competition for light and space and endogenous growth control. Spatial resource/orientation priors here are not campus measurements.

candidates.A2: Reject: sparse measured supports falsely interpreted as low foliage resources on unobserved surfaces; crown omission increased.
candidates.B: Reject: unsupported inferred lobe fill increased skyline blockage and still lost crown.
candidates.C: Reject: endpoint-only sky veto missed leaf edge incursions.
candidates.Cguard: Review only. Checks vertices+centroid in01/06, not raster-exact hard canopy-hole protection. Native holdout sky mismatch worsens0.29pp, crown omission improves0.36pp. Parent will decide after raster/actualWebGL review.
candidates.repair: Independent minimal native repair:85 attachment associations investigated,77 blades actually translated,8 were already exact after exhaustive nearest-support search;37 affected blades selected by existing web LOD. No woody geometry or other blades changed.

limitations: No species or biological growth history claimed from distant photos.
Cguard all697763 native leaves retained, but web export preserves earlier2/4/3 stable-ID LOD and therefore is not identical to native leaf population.
Camera13 participated in historical R3/R6 input;10/13 are per-patch tuning holdouts, not globally unseen.
Stem, roots, all nonterminal wood and branch joint transforms are preserved; only terminal poses plus explicitly recorded blade-root repairs.
Recorded maximum proposed rotations are targets before leaf-bound veto, not the measured surviving maximum.
No publication or runtime browser acceptance yet.

accountAdoption.structure: The returned regularize_branch requires explicit multi-view branch-correspondence targets. Those were not supplied reliably here; do not apply invented target vectors to scaffold. Preserve existing main wood/sockets, use actual native terminal supports.
accountAdoption.foliage: Applied warning that additive projected area is not union coverage and native/WebGL collections differ; rejected reducing unobserved canopy from sparse resources. Cguard keeps all native leaves and reports unchanged legacy web LOD; no claim it solves coverage consistency.
accountAdoption.review: Actual independently reproduced A2 regression caused rejection; B pixel-raster review pending, no approval inferred.
